title: Unattended Exact-Bell Policy Horizon
objective: Determine when one already-addressed outstanding assignment may receive an unattended exact bell without the clock choosing work, seats, priority, or authority.
claim_ceiling: Only the relation from a declared wake-policy condition to bell eligibility for an exact assignment. No work selection, assignment, preparation, execution authority, or open-ended scheduling.
pressure_points: Pressure time/event eligibility independently of assignment identity.
Pressure one exact due relation into the already-qualified WAKE_SOURCE_001 membrane.
Pressure replay, satisfaction, release, stale, and budget exhaustion without hidden work selection.
completion_criteria: A declared wake policy can mark one exact outstanding assignment bell-eligible without choosing the assignment.
The existing wake-source and reentry membranes remain independently responsible for bell emission and wake acceptance.
Satisfied, released, stale, obsolete, and budget-exhausted assignments cannot receive unattended bells.
stop_conditions: Wake policy starts choosing among assignments.
Time semantics are written into assignment objects.
The clock acquires execution or consequence authority.
